note: 310-DEMO-GAME-CAMPAIGN-PLAN; layers A local engine, B real Chromium local, C real site metered

cases.title: Step 1: automatic start, game calls the numbers
cases.steps: create a draft, pick a start 2 minutes ahead, publish, all players join, game starts by itself
cases.expected: numbers come every 12 s, same on every phone, no repeats

cases.title: Step 1: manual start, organizer presses Start
cases.steps: publish, players wait, organizer presses Start
cases.expected: game does not start by itself; after Start the first number comes

cases.title: Step 1: host-called numbers (organizer rolls each number)
cases.steps: start, organizer presses Roll Out the Next Number for 10 numbers
cases.expected: one number per press, never faster than the lock, same on every phone

cases.title: Step 2: who is the game for, open join
cases.steps: publish, players open the common link and join with a mobile number
cases.expected: all 9 join without approval, 10 tickets

cases.title: Step 2: who is the game for, list game with 9 listed people
cases.steps: upload list, publish, listed players join
cases.expected: listed players join directly, an unlisted one waits

cases.title: Step 3: one ticket each, early prizes only
cases.steps: play to the end of the prize list
cases.expected: each prize won once in order, game ends when all are claimed

cases.title: Step 3: two tickets each (Ticket A and B)
cases.steps: players see Ticket A and B, switch between them
cases.expected: both tickets mark; the one not played is greyed; each ticket has its own number

cases.title: Step 3: Lucky Draw 1 prize
cases.expected: one lucky winner among players, never the organizer/Host/Co-host

cases.title: Step 3: Lucky Draw 3 prizes
cases.expected: three different winners, none repeated, none from the team

cases.title: Step 3: Super Bumper with 1, 2, 5 and 10 prizes (four runs)
cases.expected: Super Bumper prizes won in order, one per player, game continues until all open prizes are won

cases.title: Step 4: breaks, brand and time zone
cases.options: opening, closing, one break, company name, time zone Dubai
cases.steps: set a message break and a brand, publish, play through the break
cases.expected: break shown to all phones at the same moment, brand strip, time zone in the start text

cases.title: Step 5: payment demo, publish and rehearsal 1-3
cases.steps: check and publish (free), start rehearsal 1, finish it, rehearsal 2, 3
cases.expected: rehearsal cards unlock in order, REHEARSAL block on the rehearsal game, real game untouched

cases.title: Join by listed employee ID
cases.expected: joins with the listed name; wrong ID waits for approval

cases.title: Join by listed email ID
cases.expected: joins; a typo is refused with the neutral text

cases.title: Not on the list, Host approves
cases.expected: waiting screen, then the ticket appears by itself

cases.title: Not on the list, Co-host approves own people only
cases.steps: player joins with the Co-host link, Co-host admits; another Co-host's person is not visible
cases.expected: Co-host sees and decides only requests from their own link

cases.title: Not on the list, Organizer approves
cases.steps: unlisted player asks, organizer admits and declines another
cases.expected: admitted gets a ticket; declined reads the polite message

cases.title: Open join with an optional email ID
cases.steps: players join, three give an email, one bad shape, one reused email
cases.expected: bad shape and reused email refused with the agreed words; no email is fine

cases.title: Duplicate mobile on another device
cases.steps: same mobile on a second browser
cases.expected: refused: one ticket plays on one device; no second ticket

cases.title: Game full: cap reached
cases.expected: told the places are taken; the first two keep their tickets

cases.title: Late join after the first numbers
cases.expected: ticket counts only from the join round, earlier numbers shown as history only

cases.title: Cached page with the old consent version
cases.steps: join from a page that sends the old version
cases.expected: told the page is out of date with a Reload button; after reload joins

cases.title: Reconnect: close the page and reopen
cases.steps: close the tab mid-game, open the link again
cases.expected: same ticket, marks kept, game position correct

cases.title: Two devices: second phone for the same ticket
cases.steps: open the personal link on a second device
cases.expected: refused with the one-device message

cases.title: Family pass: request, approve, decline
cases.steps: two family requests; host approves one, declines one
cases.expected: approved comes in, declined reads the polite message

cases.title: Family pass: 30-minute lapse and 15-minute cutoff
cases.steps: one request waits 30 minutes (test clock), one asked after the cutoff
cases.expected: lapsed message with ask again; cutoff message, organizer can still admit

cases.title: Host signs in with the Host link
cases.steps: Host opens the link, accepts the role
cases.expected: Host console shows the game; role chip says Host

cases.title: Co-host opens the Co-host link
cases.steps: Co-host accepts the role, sees the small game header
cases.expected: no names, no settings; role chip says Co-host

cases.title: Co-host limit: invite up to N people
cases.steps: four people join through the Co-host link
cases.expected: the fourth is refused or waits per the limit text

cases.title: Who approves text per role
cases.expected: organizer, Host and Co-host each read only the truthful sentence

cases.title: Organizer vs Host controls
cases.expected: Host cannot erase, pay or change prizes; can approve

cases.title: Up to 5 Hosts
cases.expected: sixth refused with the plain limit message

cases.title: Co-host without accepting
cases.expected: asked to accept the role (tick box), nothing else works

cases.title: Co-host with an old-version acceptance
cases.expected: works as before, no tick box, no reload dead end

cases.title: Co-host sees waiting list of own link only
cases.expected: each Co-host sees only their own waiting people

cases.title: Organizer removes a person and the email is released
cases.steps: organizer removes player 1, player 2 reuses the email
cases.expected: second player joins; first player cannot rejoin

cases.title: Automatic timer 12 seconds
cases.expected: gap between numbers 12 s (+/- 1 s), the same number at the same moment on all phones

cases.title: Manual start then automatic numbers
cases.expected: numbers start after Start only, then every 12 s

cases.title: Host-called numbers with the 5-second lock
cases.expected: second press inside the lock does nothing

cases.title: Pause when a claim is checked
cases.expected: claim notice on all phones; game continues as the engine does (no auto-pause)

cases.title: Pause and resume by the organizer
cases.expected: numbers stop, phones show Paused, then resume with no repeat

cases.title: No repeated numbers across 90
cases.expected: every number 1..90 exactly once, same order on all phones

cases.title: Game ends at 90 numbers
cases.options: prizes that cannot all be won
cases.expected: game ends, final screen, thank-you strip

cases.title: Game ends when all prizes are claimed
cases.expected: ends right after the last prize, not later

cases.title: Early end by the organizer
cases.expected: all phones show the game over screen

cases.title: Last numbers and called count
cases.steps: check Last 5 and N of 90 called
cases.expected: strip matches the real sequence on every phone

cases.title: Crossing a number twice un-crosses it
cases.expected: cross appears and disappears; a not-called number is refused in place

cases.title: Ticket A/B switch in a two-ticket game
cases.expected: the other is greyed, both keep marking

cases.title: Retro and Modern looks
cases.expected: page theme changes, ticket stays the rich element, cross visible in both

cases.title: Phone, tablet and laptop widths
cases.steps: open the player page at each width
cases.expected: no sideways scroll, claim button reachable

cases.title: Early Five claim, correct
cases.expected: gold CLAIM, checking notice, congratulations, prize marked won

cases.title: Top line claim, correct
cases.expected: same, winning cells gold

cases.title: Middle line claim, correct
cases.expected: same

cases.title: Bottom line claim, correct
cases.expected: same

cases.title: Four corners and Star claims
cases.expected: both accepted with the right cells

cases.title: Full House 1st to 5th
cases.expected: five different winners, in order of completion, ordinals 1..5

cases.title: Bogey: claim with nothing to claim
cases.steps: press a grey CLAIM and Submit
cases.expected: asked first; counts as a wrong claim; no prize

cases.title: Wrong claim: a stale mark
cases.expected: claim fails with Bogey; the other prizes stay open

cases.title: Late claim after the next number
cases.expected: refused as too late

cases.title: Prize already taken
cases.expected: one wins; the other reads Prize already taken

cases.title: Two winners on one number
cases.steps: two players finish on the same number
cases.expected: share: both win; next: they take consecutive positions

cases.title: Simultaneous claims by many players
cases.options: all claim in the same second
cases.expected: exactly the allowed winners, no double award

cases.title: Claim during a pause
cases.expected: handled as the engine does (accepted or refused with a clear text)

cases.title: Bystander banner for other players' claims
cases.steps: watch a phone that did not claim
cases.expected: Ticket N has claimed ... then correct / not correct / won

cases.title: Claim screens in both looks
cases.expected: the three gold CLAIM buttons (top, sticky, side) are one claim

cases.title: Super Bumper 1-10 prizes in order
cases.expected: ten prizes won in order, one per player

cases.title: Per-ticket A/B prize
cases.options: Ticket B prize on a reward line
cases.expected: prize goes to the B ticket owner, shown as Ticket B

cases.title: Lucky Draw is drawn and published
cases.expected: winner announced on every phone, never a team member

cases.title: Common link opens the join page
cases.expected: invitation text names the organizer/company; join works

cases.title: Personal link joins without a number
cases.expected: ticket without typing; second device refused

cases.title: Family link shows the family wording
cases.expected: family sentence, not for Co-host or Host links

cases.title: Co-host link never shows family words
cases.steps: open the Co-host link as a player
cases.expected: no family wording, waits for the Co-host or organizer

cases.title: Host link opens the Host console
cases.expected: Host console, not the player page

cases.title: Thank-you page after the game
cases.expected: thank-you strip with Share and WhatsApp, no rules row

cases.title: Game completed page 30 minutes later
cases.expected: hidden until the engine exposes the end time: the plain end screen is shown, never an error

cases.title: 30-minute wait message
cases.expected: polite lapsed message with ask again

cases.title: Share and WhatsApp buttons
cases.expected: link carries only the game address and a short line, no personal data

cases.title: Brochure, guide and manual links
cases.steps: open the brochure PDF, organizer guide and manual
cases.expected: 200, one page, new logo, six-item menu

cases.title: 24-hour erase of personal data
cases.expected: names, numbers, emails, seats, links gone; winners record kept

cases.title: Email key deletion on leave and decline
cases.expected: the email can be used again

cases.title: Game log is kept and complete
cases.expected: every call, claim and end reason present, no personal data

cases.title: Winners record kept for 365 days
cases.steps: read the record after the sweep
cases.expected: winning ticket numbers and prizes remain, no names

cases.title: Report e-mail and PDF
cases.expected: PDF with the new logo, correct counts

cases.title: Delete data button
cases.expected: erased at once; confirm text; game record kept

cases.title: Consent text and version are the same everywhere
cases.expected: identical wording, version 2026-10-30

cases.title: Privacy pages name what is kept
cases.expected: mobile number, optional email ID, erase within 24 hours stated

cases.title: Rehearsal data is erased with the rehearsal
cases.expected: rehearsal participants gone, real game untouched

cases.title: No personal data in URLs
cases.expected: no phone, name or email in any address

cases.title: Right to leave deletes the player's data
cases.expected: seat and details removed, others unaffected

cases.title: Data request by a player
cases.options: what do you hold about me
cases.expected: recorded without name or number; organizer told

cases.title: Offline then reload mid-game
cases.expected: Reconnecting then Back online; position correct; no duplicate marks

cases.title: Server refusals read as plain words
cases.steps: provoke each refusal the engine can send
cases.expected: every refusal has a guide entry; no raw JSON shown

cases.title: Rate limit (429) for an email or ID guess
cases.expected: 429 with the polite message, then works after the window

cases.title: Wrong organizer key
cases.steps: open the console with a wrong key
cases.expected: refused, no data shown, sign-in offered

cases.title: Expired or removed link
cases.expected: link not active message

cases.title: Stale page after a release
cases.expected: reload message and button (see G2)

cases.title: Double submit of Join and Claim
cases.expected: one ticket, one claim

cases.title: Game cancelled by the organizer
cases.steps: cancel before and during the game
cases.expected: calm screen for players; data erased within a day

cases.title: Payment pending locks the game
cases.expected: players told the organizer's payment is not complete; nobody can join

cases.title: Free launch limit
cases.expected: refused with the plain limit message
